MAIN WORK COMPLETE. Deliverable: `/workspace/analysis.py` (8.7 KB, self-contained, numpy-only, `make_agent(env_spec, seed)` + `act`/`observe` exactly per contract, optional hooks never required). Frozen design: **two-stream blended optimistic Q-learning** — per (h,s,a) scalar statistics only; drift-immune MC-return stream (single backward sweep over the one bounded current-episode trace at `observe(done=True)`) blended via w(n)=1/(1+n/κ) with a one-step bootstrap stream whose targets use **honest** next-value estimates (max over MC-stream means, optimistic-init fallback — no optimism compounding through the target chain); Bernstein-style bonus c_var·√(var_mix·L/n) + c_range·(R_h·rmax)·L/n with capped mixture variance (stream disagreement inflates variance); greedy optimistic argmax with visit-based tie-breaking. Frozen shared config: κ=4.0, c_var=0.05, c_range=0.03. No branching on case_id/dimensions/patterns.

== OFFICIAL PROTOCOL RESULTS (public_calibration_runner.py, paired seeds 314159/418888/523617) ==
| case | ours | UCB-B | strong ref | ours/strong | 1.05× bar |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| noisy_fork | 16.71 | 26.34 | 8.25 | 2.03 | 8.66 |
| variance_cascade | −4.24 (≤0 in expectation is impossible; negative = sampling luck, cf. strong's σ=13.2) | 10.24 | 0.99 | — | 1.04 |
| stable_volatile | 18.56 | 32.75 | 16.62 | 1.12 | 17.45 |
| TOTAL (3 seeds) | 93.10 | 207.99 | 77.57 | 1.20 | — |
0 invalid actions, 0 errors on every case/seed. Materially beats plain UCB-B (2.2× better total).

== WHY THE FROZEN CONFIG DIFFERS FROM THE OFFICIAL-SEED-OPTIMAL ONE (important) ==
An earlier variant (optimism-compounded bootstrap targets) scored 79.9 total = 1.03× strong on the official 3 seeds, but instrumentation showed a systematic bias floor: its value estimates ran ~1.7 above truth (e.g. 4.82 vs true 3.09) while hub arm gaps were only ~0.018–0.065, causing persistent wrong commitments (493/520 suboptimal hub plays on one seed) and heavy tails on non-official seeds. I therefore validated all finalists on a 27-seed internal panel (official 3 + 24 extra; selection only — official reporting above uses only the paired seeds):
| config | tot official-3 | tot 27-seed mean | worst-seed cells (fork/casc/volat) |
|---|---|---|---|
| A opt-targets cv.05 cr.01 | 79.9 (1.03×) | 72.3 | 62 / 40 / 99 |
| P mean-targets cv.10 cr.03 | ~91 | 65.0 | 58 / 48 / 72 |
| **S mc-targets cv.05 cr.03 (FROZEN)** | 93.1 (1.20×) | **58.4** | **59 / 38 / 60** |
S is the robust choice: best 27-seed mean, best tails, and structurally principled (no bias floor) — safer for hidden families that are explicitly "not structural representatives" of the diagnostics. c_dis (disagreement bonus) and doubling-forced balanced sampling were both implemented, tested, and rejected (no improvement; the latter hurt fork by forcing near-1:1 sampling on small-gap arms).

== ROBUSTNESS CHECKS ==
• Small-K (K/4): ours vs my UCB-B reimplementation = 0.90×/0.69×/1.02× — no blow-up at smaller budgets.
• Synthetic hidden-like stress test (random MDPs at hidden-case dimensions S=7A3H14K720, S=5A2H14K480, S=8A3H13K630; 30% stochastic rows, ~50% nonzero rewards — harder than public cases), deterministic and with N(0,0.1) reward noise: ours/UCB-B = 0.95–1.09, 0 invalid actions under all conditions. Reward noise changes ratios by ≤0.01–0.03 → the noisy-reward assumption is not fragile.
• Hook-free scorer loop verified; all Q values stay within [0,(H−h)·rmax]; act returns proper ints.

== RUNTIME ==
Full official suite: 3.35 s (UCB-B reported 2.80 s) — same order; ~1.2 s per case-run.

== COMPLIANCE AUDIT (all PASS) ==
Prohibited → status: explicit transition model estimation → none (no P̂ anywhere); next-state count tensors / H·S·A·S storage → none (arrays are (H,S,A) only: 6 scalars/cell); replay-based planning → none (only the current episode's bounded trace, explicitly permitted; no stored past transitions); posterior sampling → none (deterministic optimistic index); policy gradient/deep RL → none; next-state enumeration updates → none (updates only at observed (h,s,a) cells and along the visited trace); storage O(H·S·A) + O(H) trace ✔; one shared config, no case/dimension branching ✔; valid horizon-indexed values ✔; invalid actions 0 ✔.

== VALIDATED vs ASSUMED ==
Validated on public diagnostics (official runner, paired seeds): the frozen constants, honest-target mechanism, blend weight κ, bonus multipliers, superiority over UCB-B, robustness across 27 seeds, small-K behavior, noisy-reward insensitivity.
Still assumptions (unverifiable): hidden MDPs use deterministic-per-(h,s,a) rewards like the public cases (mitigated: stress test shows noise-robustness); hidden K/H in the stated ranges; hidden scorer = same runner protocol (design does not depend on optional hooks); dynamically regenerated strong references behave like the public ones (fork is near its Lai–Robbins limit σ²·2·lnT/Δ≈14 vs strong's 8.25, so some families' 1.05× bars may be luck-sensitive for any method).

== LIMITATIONS ==
On small-gap hub structures (gap ≲ 0.05 with target std ≈ 0.3) no method using only scalar target statistics can resolve the gap within K≈500 episodes; residual regret there is dominated by commitment luck, which the strong reference shares. The official-3-seed ratio (1.20×) is a small-sample view; the 27-seed panel (best mean and tails of all tested variants) is the more reliable indicator. Calibration grid was ~140 configs; deeper architecture search (e.g., per-horizon shared statistics) was out of scope.

frozen_config.targ_source: honest MC-mean next values, optimistic-init fallback
frozen_config.streams: MC return-to-go (trace sweep at done) + one-step bootstrap, Welford mean/M2, blended by w(n)=1/(1+n/kappa)
frozen_config.bonus: c_var*sqrt(var_mix*L/n) + c_range*(R_h*rmax)*L/n, capped mixture variance incl. stream-disagreement term
